hostname E1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description to R1
 ip address 10.0.0.18 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description hosts
 ip address 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.0
 ip access-group TO_E1 out
 no shutdown
!
router ospf 1
 network 10.0.0.16 0.0.0.3 area 0
 network 10.1.1.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
!
ip access-list extended TO_E1
 10 permit tcp 10.1.3.0 0.0.0.255 10.1.1.0 0.0.0.255 eq 22
 20 permit tcp 10.1.2.0 0.0.0.255 10.1.1.0 0.0.0.255 eq 80
 30 permit tcp 10.1.2.0 0.0.0.255 10.1.1.0 0.0.0.255 eq 21
 40 permit tcp 10.1.4.0 0.0.0.255 10.1.1.0 0.0.0.255 eq 445
 50 permit tcp 10.1.3.0 0.0.0.255 10.1.1.0 0.0.0.255 eq 143
 60 permit tcp 10.1.3.0 0.0.0.255 10.1.1.0 0.0.0.255 eq 443
!
